item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"claim_1","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"The program mocks the local launch boundary so `LocalProvider.launch` can run without a real server: it provides an `sglang` import, substitutes `get_free_port`, `wait_for_server`, `subprocess.Popen`, and `threading.Thread`, and launches against an LM-like object with mutable `kwargs`.","span_ids":["e1","e2"]},{"claim_id":"claim_2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"Starting from a model string like `openai/huggingface/my-org/my-model`, the program shows that `launch` strips the public prefixes before launch so the effective model path becomes `my-org/my-model`.","span_ids":["e3"]},{"claim_id":"claim_3","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"The program captures the command passed to `subprocess.Popen` and verifies the exact list-form launcher command: `python`, `-m`, `sglang.launch_server`, `--model-path`, the normalized model, `--port`, the mocked port as a string, `--host`, and `0.0.0.0`.","span_ids":["e4","e5"]},{"claim_id":"claim_4","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"After launch, the program asserts that DSPy writes `lm.kwargs[\"api_base\"]` as `http://localhost:{port}/v1` and `lm.kwargs[\"api_key\"]` as `local`, using the same port selected for the server.","span_ids":["e4","e6"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"e1","path":"dspy/clients/lm_local.py","start_line":29,"end_line":36},{"span_id":"e2","path":"tests/clients/test_lm_local.py","start_line":67,"end_line":85},{"span_id":"e3","path":"dspy/clients/lm_local.py","start_line":46,"end_line":53},{"span_id":"e4","path":"dspy/clients/lm_local.py","start_line":56,"end_line":68},{"span_id":"e5","path":"tests/clients/test_lm_local.py","start_line":87,"end_line":97},{"span_id":"e6","path":"dspy/clients/lm_local.py","start_line":124,"end_line":128}]}
